original: vivādasya bhinnaviṣayatvāyogādatrta tyāgasaṃnyāsaśabdayorekārthatvāvaśyambhāvāt pṛthagarthatvaśaṅkāparihāro'rthalabdha ityāha tatreti| etena, saṃnyāsatyāgaśa bdayoḥ pṛthagarthatvamaṅgīkṛtya kasyacit kāmyasvarūpa prahāṇaviṣayatayākasyacitu nityanaimittikaphalopekṣārthatāṃ ca vadantaḥ pratyuktāḥ| na hṛtrta kāmyetarakarmaṃphalatyāgamityucyate|

original: tataśca saṃkocakābhāvāt trtividhamapi karma saṃgṛhrati sarvakarmeti| tadidamuktam nityānāṃ naimittikānāṃ kāmyānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ karmaṇā miti| nityānāmapi , 'prājāpatyaṃ gṛhasthānām' ityādinā phalasaṃyogo'vagataḥ|| atrta śloke tyāgasaṃnyāsaśabdayorarthabhedavyatpādanaparatāṃ nirasitumaikāthrye praspaṣṭaṃ hetudvamāha tatheti|
analyzed: tatas ca saṃkocaka abhāvāt trtividham api karma saṃgṛhrati sarva karma iti tat idam uktam nityānām naimittikānām kāmyānām ca sarveṣām karmaṇām iti nityānām api prājāpatyam gṛhasthānām ityādinā phala saṃyogaḥ uvagataḥ śloke tyāga saṃnyāsa śabdayoḥ artha bheda vyatpādana para tām nirasitum aikāthrye praspaṣṭam hetu dvam āha tathā iti

original: na hrarthadvayavivaye'trta vimarśe anyatarasyaiva niścaya upapanna ityabhiprāyeṇoktam tyāgaśabdenai veti| parasparaparyāyatādarśanāñceti | ayamabhiprāyaḥ -- 'niyatasya tu saṃnyāsaḥ karmaṇo nopapadyate' iti niṣiddha eva hi saṃnyāsaḥ karmaṇā 'mohāt tasya parityāgaḥ' iti tyāgaśabdenānūdya tāmasatvena nindyate;
analyzed: vimarśe anyatarasya eva niścayaḥ upapannaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa uktam tyāga śabdena vā iti paraspara paryāya tā darśanāt ca iti ayam abhiprāyaḥ niyatasya tu saṃnyāsaḥ karmaṇaḥ na upapadyate iti niṣiddhaḥ eva hi saṃnyāsaḥ karmaṇā mohāt tasya parityāgaḥ iti tyāga śabdena anūdya tāmasa tvena nindyate

original: anthā jaradgavādivākyāt parasparānvayaprasaṅgāt| evaṃ 'bhavatyagināṃ pretya ityukte' evārthaḥ 'na tu saṃnyāsināṃ kavacit' iti vyatirekenaṇa ddaḍhīkriyate| na ca tadanyāvidhiranyābhāvasya vyatirekaḥ| ata imau śabdāvatrtāpyekārthāviti| aṅgīkṛtamiti| prativaktatrtā bhagavateti śeṣaḥ||2||
analyzed: anthā jaradgava ādi vākyāt paraspara anvaya prasaṅgāt evam bhavati aginām pretya iti ukte eva arthaḥ na tu saṃnyāsinām ddaḍhīkriyate na ca tad anya vidhiḥ anya abhāvasya vyatirekaḥ atas imau aṅgīkṛtam iti bhagavatā iti śeṣaḥ

original: kāmyānā miti ślokena phalavirodhatadabhāvadvārā virodho darśitaḥ| atha tyājyaṃ doṣavat iti ślokena svarūpato doṣayogatadabhāvāmyāṃ pratyavāyakara tvādiṃmukhena vivādaḥ pradaśryate| vaidhahiṃsa'pi kāpilairniṣiddhatvena doṣatayāṅgīkriyate| yathoktarmāśvarakṛṣṇena, "ddaṣṭavadānuśravikaḥ sa hraviśuddhikṣayātiśayayuktaḥ" iti|
analyzed: kāmyānām iti ślokena phala virodha tad abhāva dvārā virodhaḥ darśitaḥ atha tyājyam doṣavat iti ślokena svarūpataḥ doṣa yoga tad abhāvābyām pratyavāya kara tva ādiṃmukhena vivādaḥ pradaśryate kāpilaiḥ niṣiddha tvena doṣatayā aṅgīkriyate yathā ukta ṛmāśvarakṛṣṇena sa hravi śuddhi kṣaya atiśaya yuktaḥ iti

original: uktaṃ ca pañcaśikhācāryaiḥ, "syāt svaphalssaṃkarassupariharassapratyavamarṣaḥ"iti| ataḥ 'vaidhahiṃsā puruṣasya doṣamāvakṣyati, kratoścopakariṣyati' iti tanmatam| ataḥ eke iti śabdena sāmānyato
analyzed: uktam ca pañcaśikha ācāryaiḥ syāt sva phalaḥ saṃkaraḥ su pariharaḥ sa pratyavamarṣaḥ iti atas vaidha hiṃsā puruṣasya doṣam āvakṣyati kratoḥ ca upakariṣyati iti tat matam atas eke iti śabdena sāmānyatas

original: nirdiṣṭā vādinaḥ doṣavaditi hetvanvayādisāmathryāt doṣākhyaddaṣṭāntoktibalādvā viśeṣato vyañnta ityāha kāpilā vaidikāśca tanmatānusāriṇa iti| etena sarvakarmasvarūpasaṃnyāsavādināṃ matamapi vedabāhratvena darśitam| rāgādidoṣava diti| ragādayodoṣā bandhākā iti sarvasaidvāntikasaṃmatatvāt tadudāharaṇam; yadvā karmaiva rāgādidoṣavat;
analyzed: nirdiṣṭāḥ vādinaḥ doṣa vat iti hetu anvaya ādi sāmathryāt doṣa ākhya daṣṭānta ukti balāt vā viśeṣataḥ iti āha kāpilāḥ vaidikāḥ ca tad mata anusāriṇaḥ iti etena sarva karma svarūpa saṃnyāsa vādinām matam api veda bāhra tvena darśitam rāga ādi doṣa vat iti raga ādayaḥ doṣāḥ iti sarva saidvāntika saṃmata tvāt tat udāharaṇam yat vā karma eva rāga ādi doṣa vat

original: ata eva bandhakamityabhiprāyaḥ| asyāṃ yojanāyāmādiśabdo hiṃsādikamapi saṃgṛhṇati| sarvaṃ yajñādikaṃ karme ti karmaśabdo'trta sāmānyaviṣayo'pi yajñadānatapaḥ karma na tyājyamiti pakṣāntare viśeṣamāt śāruācoditaviṣayaḥ tatrta ca viśeṣākābhāvāt kāmyaviṣayatve paunaruktyāñca sarvaviṣaya iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: atas eva bandhakam iti abhiprāyaḥ asyām yojanāyām ādi śabdaḥ hiṃsā ādikam api saṃgṛhṇati sarvam yajña ādikam karma iti yajña dāna tapaḥ karma na tyājyam iti pakṣa antare ca sarva viṣayaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: sarvaistyājyatve tadvidhāyakasya śāruāsyāprāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt mumukṣuṇe ti viśeṣitam| aparaśa bdo'trta svamatānusāriviṣayaḥ| yajñadānatapaḥ karma na tyājyaṃ kāryameva taditi hi svamataṃ vakṣyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha paṇḍitā iti| tyājyopādeyavibhāgatattvavida ityarthaḥ||3||
analyzed: sarvaiḥ tyājya tve tad vidhāyakasya śāru āsya aprāmāṇya prasaṅgāt mumukṣuṇā iti viśeṣitam aparaḥ sva mata anusāri viṣayaḥ yajña dāna tapaḥ karma na tyājyam kāryam eva tat iti hi sva matam vakṣyate iti abhiprāyeṇa āha paṇḍitāḥ iti tyājya upādeya vibhāga tattva vidaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tatrtetiśabdaḥ prakṛte vipratipattiviṣayatānuvādamukhena nyāyapravṛttiṣayasaṃdigdhatādyotaka ityabhiprāyeṇāha evaṃ vādivipratipanna iti| me niśca mitayanena matāntaretthānaśaṅkāvyudāsāyāha tyāgaviṣayaṃ niścayaṃ mattaśśṛṇviti| mattaḥ
analyzed: tatrta iti śabdaḥ prakṛte vipratipatti viṣaya tā anuvāda mukhena nyāya pravṛtti ṣaya saṃdigdha tā dyotakaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa āha evam vādi vipratipannaḥ iti me mitayanena mata antara itthāna śaṅkā vyudāsāya āha tyāga viṣayam niścayam mattaḥ śṛṇu iti mattaḥ

original: bhramādidoṣarahitādityarthaḥ| tyāgo hītyā dikaṃ na vakṣyaṇāṇa sāttvikādityāgatrtaividhyaviṣayam; kiṃ tu sāttavikatyāgāvāntarabhedaviṣayam, saṃprakīrtitaḥ ityasya prāguktatatparatvasvārasyāt, hiśabdena śrotṛsaṃpratipattyādipratīteścetyabhiprāyeṇāha tyāgaḥ kriyamāṇeṣvevetyā di|
analyzed: bhrama ādi doṣa rahitāt iti arthaḥ tyāgaḥ hi ityā dikam na kim tu sāttavika tyāga avāntarabheda viṣayam saṃprakīrtitaḥ iti asya prāgukta tatparatva svārasyāt hiśabdena śrotṛ saṃpratipatti ādi pratīteḥ ca iti abhiprāyeṇa āha tyāgaḥ kriyamāṇeṣu eva ityā dikam

original: mayī sarvāṇī tyeta eva ślokariuāvidhatyāgapara iti atrta niṣphānuṣṭhānasvarūpatyāgaṃ, sāṅkhyataśaṅkāṃ ca pratikṣeptum, trtayāṇāṃ svarūpaṃ vivinakti karmajanya mityādinā| madīyaphalasādhanataye tyādi| svakīyaprītisādhanatayā svārthameva bhagavān pravartayatīti hi mumukṣoranusaṃdhānamiti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: sarvāṇī tyete eva śloka riuāvidha tyāga paraḥ iti atrta sāṅkhyata śaṅkām ca pratikṣeptum sva rūpam vivinakti karma janyam ityādinā madīya phala sādhanataye tyādi svakīya prīti sādhanatayā svārtham eva bhagavān pravartayati iti hi mumukṣoḥ anusaṃdhānam iti bhāvaḥ
sva kartṛ tvasya tādadhīnya tad anumati sāpekṣa tva ādibhiḥ sarveśvare kartṛ tva anusaṃdhānam kartṛ tva tyāgaḥ tu aneka kartṛke para prayukta sva ātma kartṛk tava anusandhānam iti
viśodhayiṣyate

original: evaṃ trtividhatyāgānuvādasya svarūpatyāgavyavacchedārthatocyate yajñadāne tyādinā| vividiṣādyutpatteḥ prākyajñādikamanuṣṭheyam, paścātu parityājyamityākhyātīti kecit; tanmatavyudāsāyāha na kadācidapīti| 'sa khalvevaṃ vartayam yāvadāyuṣam' iti śrutyabhiprāyeṇāha api tvāprayāṇāditi| tathāca sūtrtam 'āprayāṇāt tatrtāpi hi ddaṣṭam' iti|
analyzed: evam trtividha tyāga anuvādasya svarūpa tyāga vyavaccheda artha tā ucyate yajña dāne tyādinā vividiṣā ādi utpatteḥ prāk yajña ādikam anuṣṭheyam paścāt tu parityājyam iti ākhyāti iti kecid tad mata vyudāsāya āha na kadācid api iti sa khalu evam vartayam yāvadāyuṣam iti śruti abhiprāyeṇa āha api tu āprayāṇāt iti tathā ca āprayāṇāt hi ddaṣṭam iti

original: aharahariti coditakālopalakṣaṇam| nanu vidyāniṣṭhasya kimarthaṃ karma ? na tāvadārādupakāritvena; samuñcayādipakṣānabhyupagamāt| nāpi tattvajñānārtham saparikarāt pramāṇādeva tatsiddheḥ|
analyzed: ahar ahar iti ca udita kāla upalakṣaṇam nanu vidyā niṣṭhasya kimartham karma na tāvat ārāt upakāri tvena samuñcaya ādi pakṣa anabhyupagamāt nā api tattva jñāna artham sa parikarāt pramāṇāt eva tad siddheḥ

original: na ca tadanusmaraṇarūpopāsānārtham tasyāpi saṃskārapāṭavādisādhyatvāt na cānyat kiñcit karmaṃsādhyaṃ mumukṣvapekṣitaṃ prayojanaṃ paśyāmaḥ na ca prayojanamanuddiśya mandasyāpi pravṛttirityabhiprāyeṇa kuta ityākāṅkṣāpradarśanam| cakāro'nuktasamuñcayārtha ityabhiprāyeṇa prabhṛti śabdaḥ| varṇāśramasaṃbandhī nīti|
analyzed: na ca tad anusmaraṇa rūpa upāsāna artham tasya api saṃskāra pāṭava ādi sādhya tvāt na ca anyat kiñcid karmaṃsādhyam mumukṣu apekṣitam prayojanam paśyāmaḥ na ca prayojanam an uddiśya mandasya api pravṛttiḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa kutas iti ākāṅkṣā pradarśanam cakāraḥ unukta samuñcaya arthaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa prabhṛti śabdaḥ varṇa āśrama saṃbandhī nīti

original: nityanaimittikānāmapi svarūpatyāga iti yaḥ pakṣaḥ, sa iha pratikṣipyata iti bhāvaḥ| yajñādīnāṃ sannipatyopakāradyotanāyopakartavyajñānasvarūpaparo'tra manīṣiśabda ityabhiprāyeṇāha mananaśīlānā miti| manasa īṣiṇo manīṣiṇa iti vyutpatau phalitoktiriyam| śravaṇānantarabhāviyauktikabhananavyavacchedāyāha mananamupāsanamiti|
analyzed: nitya naimittikānām api svarūpa tyāgaḥ iti yaḥ pakṣaḥ saḥ iha pratikṣipyate iti bhāvaḥ yajña ādīnām sannipatya upakāra dyotanāya upakartavya jñāna sva rūpa paraḥ atra manīṣi śabdaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa āha manana śīlānām iti manasaḥ īṣiṇaḥ manīṣiṇaḥ iti vyutpatau phalita uktiḥ iyam śravaṇa anantara bhāvi yauktika bhanana vyavacchedāya āha mananam upāsanam iti

original: pāvanāni manīṣiṇa miti samabhivyāhārasiddhamupakāraprakāraṃ vyanakti mumukṣūṇāmityādinā| 'prāyaṇāntamokāramabhidhyāyīta' iti pakramya 'yaḥ punaretaṃ trtimātrteṇomityanenaivākṣareṇa paraṃ puruṣamabhidhyāyīta' ityapāsanaṃ yāvañcīvamanuṣṭheyamiti nigamyate| atastadaṅgamapi yāvajjīvamanuṣṭheyam|
analyzed: pāvanāni manīṣiṇam iti samabhivyāhāra siddham upakāra prakāram vyanakti mumukṣūṇām ityādinā prāyaṇa antam okāram abhidhyāyīta iti yaḥ punar etam yaḥ punar etam trti mātrteṇa om iti anena eva akṣareṇa param puruṣam abhidhyāyīta iti apāsanam yāvañcīvam anuṣṭheyam iti nigamyate atas tad aṅgam api yāvajjīvam anuṣṭheyam

original: tañca, 'sa khalvevaṃ vartayan yāvadāyuṣam' ityādibhirvaṇryata iti bhāvaḥ| upāsanavaduttarādhanivartakatvābhāvāt prajīnaśabdaḥ||5||
analyzed: tat ca sa khalu evam vartayan yāvadāyuṣam ityādibhiḥ vaṇryate iti bhāvaḥ upāsana vat uttara adha nivartaka tva abhāvāt prajīna śabdaḥ

original: evaṃ pāvanatvoktyā tyājyaṃ doṣavaditi pakṣaḥ pratikṣiptaḥ| niścayaṃ śṛṇvityādinokta evārthaḥ etānyapīti ślokena nirdoṣatvādhyabasāyārthaṃ nigamanātmanā ddaḍhīkriyā ityapunaruktiḥ| hetusādhyabhāvena pūrvottaragranthau saṃgamayati yasmāditi| manīṣiśabdasūcitopāsanasamānayogakṣematādyotanāya api śabda ityāha upāsanavadetānyapī ti|
analyzed: evam pāvana tva uktyā tyājyam doṣa vat iti pakṣaḥ pratikṣiptaḥ niścayam śṛṇu ityādinā uktaḥ eva arthaḥ etāni api iti ślokena nirdoṣa tva adhyabasāya artham nigamana ātmanā ddaḍhīkriyā iti apunaruktiḥ hetu sādhya bhāvena pūrva uttara granthau saṃgamayati yasmāt iti manīṣi śabda sūcita upāsana samāna yogakṣema tā dyotanāya api śabdaḥ iti āha upāsana vat etāni api iti

original: paramātmaprītidvārā karmaṇāṃ pāvanatvādisiddhayarthamāha madārādhanarūpāṇīti| saṅgaśabdasya phalatyāgoktyā punarukti pariharati karmaṇi mamatā miti| niścita miti| nātrta punastvayā saṃśayitavyamiti
analyzed: paramātma prīti dvārā karmaṇām pāvana tva ādi siddhayartham āha mad ārādhana rūpāṇi iti saṅga śabdasya phala tyāga uktyā punarukti pariharati karmaṇi mamatā miti niścita miti punar tvayā saṃśayitavyam iti

original: bhāvaḥ| uttamamiti asarvajñānāmapyeṣāmetadviruddhaṃ svarūpatyāgādimataṃ sarvamadhamatvādanādaraṇīyamiti bhāvaḥ||6||
analyzed: bhāvaḥ uttamam iti asarvajñānām api eṣām etat viruddham svarūpa tyāga ādi matam sarvam adhama tvāt anādaraṇīyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: atha niyatasyetyādinā matāntarāṇāmadhamatvaṃ svamatasyottamatvaṃ ca prapañcayate| varṇāśramaprayuktatayā dustyajatvaṃ niyataśabdenābhipretamityāha nityanaimittikasyeti| tu śabdasahitaḥ saṃnyāsaśabdo'trta tyājyaṃ doṣavadityatrtasvarūpatyāgānuvādī sa eva hi mohāttasya parityāgaḥ ityutarārdhena nindyata ityabhiprāyeṇa saṃnyāsastayā ityuktaḥ|
analyzed: atha niyatasya ityādinā mata antarāṇām adhamatvam sva matasya uttamatvam ca prapañcayate varṇa āśrama prayuktatayā dustyaja tvam niyata śabdena abhipretam iti āha nitya naimittikasya iti tu śabda sahitaḥ tyājyam doṣavat iti atrta svarūpa tyāga anuvādī saḥ eva hi mohāt tasya parityāgaḥ iti utara ardhena nindyate iti abhiprāyeṇa saṃnyāsaḥ tayā iti uktaḥ

original: pāvanatvenāvaśyakartavyatve śiṣṭe, punaḥ tyāgonapapadyata iti śāsanaṃ prākprapaccitaddaṣṭāddaṣṭānupapattismāraṇaparamityābhiprāyeṇānupaparti vivṛṇoti śarīrayātrtā'pīti| kevalāśanādinā'pi lokikadehayātrtā sidhyedityātrtāha śarīrayātrtā hīti| "pañca bhūtātmakairbhogaiḥ āpyāyanamityātrtāha annamayaṃ hīti|
analyzed: pāvana tvena avaśya kartavya tve śiṣṭe punar iti śāsanam prāk prapaccita daṣṭāt daṣṭa anupapatti smāraṇa param iti ābhiprāyeṇa anupaparti vivṛṇoti śarīra yātrtā api iti kevala aśana ādinā api lokika deha yātrtā sidhyet iti ātrtā āha śarīra yātrtā hi iti pañca bhūta ātmakaiḥ bhogaiḥ āpyāyanam iti ātrtā āha anna mayam hi iti

original: sāttvikāhaṃkārakāryasyānnavikāratvāsaṃbhāvādāpyāyanoktiḥ|smṛtilambhe sarvagranthīnāṃ vipramokṣaḥ"bhidyate hradayagranthiḥ ityādikayā samānārthayā śrutyā darśanaśabdena viśeṣyata ityabhiprāyeṇa brāhrasākṣātkārarūpamityuktam| viśadatamatvāt sākṣātkārektiriha bhāvyā| sakṛdanuṣṭhitasya vidyopakāritvaśaṅkāṃ parihāram nigamayati tasmāditi|

analyzed: iti abhiprāyeṇa āha guṇataḥ vibhṛtitaḥ api āha miti guṇa śabdaḥ atra nirūpita svarūpa viśeṣaka jñāna śakya ādi samasta dharma viṣayaḥ yāvān yaḥ ca iti anayoḥ vyutkrameṇa vyākhyānam tattvataḥ iti asya yāvān yaḥ ca iti atra anapekṣaṇāt abhijānāti tyatra saṃśaya ādi vyudāsāya tad apekṣaṇāt ca tattvataḥ abhijānāti iti yojitam

original: bhaktyā tvananyaye tyādau praveśe'pi hetutayā bhaktereva prāguktatvācca tato bhaktito māṃ viśate ityevānvayo darśitaḥ| praveṣṭumiti prāguktaikāthryajñāpanāya parasmaipadasidvaye ca praviśatī tyuktam| yathāvajjñānamapi kāṣṭhāprāptabhakteḥ| anyonyāśrayaṇaṃ ca bhakteḥ parvabhedāt parihmatam|

original: saiva tu tathāvidhāvasthā sākṣāt mokṣasādhanamityāha tattvata ityādinā| darśana śabdenānubhāṣaṇāt tattvato'bhijānātī tyasya sākṣātkāraparatvaṃ vyañjitam| 'parabhaktyā'pi tattvajñānameva sādhyam; tadeva tu sākṣānmokṣasādhanam' iti kuddaṣṭimatamapākaroti atre ti| eva kāreṇa darśanavyavacchedaḥ|

original: vihitakarmaṇāṃ pūrvamuktatvāt sarvakarmāṇyapī ti niṣidvānuṣṭhānaṃ bhagavadananyatātastutyarthamupakṣipyata iti svairābhilaṣiśaṅkarādimatamapākaroti idānīṃ kāmyānāmapi karmaṇā miti| sarvaśabdo'tra śāstrīyeṣvevānuktasaṃgrahamārtha iti bhāvaḥ| tadeva vivṛṇoti na kevala mityādinā|

original: uktaṃ paramapuruṣārthasādhanatvamanantaropāyānuśāsanaheturityāha yasmādeva miti| cetaśśabdasāphalyāya tadabhiprataṃ cetaso bhagavati karmasaṃnyāsakaraṇatvaṃ yena prakāreṇa, tamāha ātmano madīyatvamanniyābhyatvabudva yeti| atra cetaśśabdasyaivaṃ tātparyaṃ prācīnasaviśeṣaṇanirdeśena sthāpayati uktaṃ hī ti| adhyatmacetasā|

original: paraśeṣatvādiviśeṣitayathātmagocarabuddhayetyarthaḥ| sarvaśabdena svarūpakātsnyavat anubandhikātsnyamapi prāguktaprakāreṇābhipretamityāha sakartṛkāṇi sārādhyānī ti| buddhiyogaśabdena mumukṣorasādhāraṇamakartṛtvānusaṃdhānādikaṃ sarvaṃ pratyabhijñāpyata pratyabhijñāpyata ityāha imameva buddhiyoga miti||
analyzed: para śeṣatva ādi viśeṣita yathā ātma gocara buddhayā iti arthaḥ sarva śabdena svarūpa kātsnya vat anubandhi kātsnyam api prāc ukta prakāreṇa abhipretam iti āha sa kartṛkāṇi sa ārādhyāni iti buddhi yoga śabdena mumukṣoḥ asādhāraṇam akartṛ tva anusaṃdhāna ādikam sarvam pratyabhijñāpyata pratyabhijñāpyate iti āha imam eva buddhi yogam iti

original: mañcittassarvadurgāṇī tyatrā mañcittaśabdena pūrvaślokoktasyaivānuvādāt tatrā ca buddhiviśeṣaviśiṣṭakarmavidhiparatvāt uttareṣvapi grantheṣu yuddhākhyasvadharmaprotsāhanasyaiva sphuṭatvādihāpi tadvivakṣāmāha evaṃ mañcittassarbakarmāṇi kurvanniti| mañcittatvamātrāsya vidheyatve anantaraṃ yuddhanivṛttyadhvasāyapratikṣepo na saṃgacchata iti bhāvaḥ|
analyzed: mad cittaḥ sarva durgāṇi mad citta śabdena pūrva śloka uktasya eva anuvādāt tatrā ca buddhi viśeṣa viśiṣṭa karma vidhi paratvāt uttareṣu api grantheṣu yuddha ākhya svadharma protsāhanasya eva sphuṭa tvāt iha api tad vivakṣām āha evam mad cittaḥ sarva karmāṇi kurvan iti mad citta tva mātrā asya vidheya tve anantaram yuddha nivṛtti adhva sāya pratikṣepaḥ na saṃgacchate iti bhāvaḥ

original: durgaśabdasya girivanajalādidurgeṣu prasiddhiprakarṣāt kṣatriyasya cārjunasyayuyutsostannistārāpekṣāsaṃbhavāt tadviṣayatvāśaṅkāmapyapākartuṃ pūrvāparānurodhena sāṃsārikāṇī ti viśeṣitam|

original: matprasādādi tyanena vyutpattyanuśāsanaśrutismṛtyādiruddhāpūrvādikalpanāvyudāsaḥ, svasya phalapradāne pratibandhanivṛttyādimātrāsākāṅkṣatvaṃ ca sūcyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha matprasādādeve ti|
analyzed: mad prasāda ādi ti anena vyutpatti anuśāsana śruti smṛti ādi ruddha apūrva ādi kalpanā vyudāsaḥ svasya phala pradāne pratibandha nivṛtti ādi mātra asākāṅkṣatvam ca sūcyate iti abhiprāyeṇa āha mad prasādāt eva iti

original: evaṃ nityanaimittikakāmyarūpāṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ buddhiviśeṣeniyamādiyogena karmayogaśabditānāṃ paramparayā paripūrṇabhagavatprāptiparyantaṃ vipākamupapādya sarvathā karmayoga eva te kartavya iti nigamitam| atha tadakaraṇe pratyavāyamāha atha cedityardhena|

original: hitavacanānādarasya nimittabhūtamahaṅkāraviśeṣamāha ahameva kṛtyākṛtyaviṣayaṃ sarvaṃ jānāmīti bhāvāditi| na śroṣyasīti śrūyamāṇe'pi śrutaphalanivṛttyabhiprāyam| vinaṅkṣyasītnenādikālamanuvṛttasyātmanāśasyottaraphe'pyanuvṛttirvivakṣitetyabhiprāyeṇāha -- vinaṣṭo bhaviṣyasīti| 'budvināśātpraṇaśyati' iti prāguktapratyabhijñānapanamiti bhāvaḥ|
